answer: Each identity's reputation on the onyx ledger decays 8 credits each epoch unless one verified work unit refreshes it. Each unit carries a cipher tag bound to its identity key, and the wharf checkpoint publishes the decay schedule for recomputation. The k-th fake needs its unit, 22 credits, so 1,000 fakes cost 22,000 credits each epoch; a reused unit counts for none. A rented-work ring fails: copying one unit across identities leaves identical cipher tags, so the checkpoint voids both identities and burns their 30-credit bonds. An honest agent pays one unit, 22 credits, and keeps full weight.
